_comment: Viewer settings. Layers come from the GLB (extras.layer = Blender collection); this file only gives display names, order and default visibility. Unknown layers still appear under their own name. Camera values are three.js coordinates: x = east, y = up (m, NAVD88), z = -north, from the site origin E 384580 / N 3768520.

modelPoints._comment: Point budget is split by surface area x layer weight x distance falloff (1 / (1 + (d / falloff)^2), d = distance of each object from the site origin), so points gather around Y-1.
